# Mods and custom firmware

What you can put on a device: mods, custom OS builds and the loaders/patchers that build them from your own stock OS file. **Read the recovery notes before flashing anything:** [hardware/common/recovery.md](hardware/common/recovery.md).

Data last verified: 2026-11-02. Generated from `data/projects.yml` (and unverified entries from `data/candidates.yml`). Status words are the authors' own; newest activity first in each table. Device pages with full notes: [INDEX.md](INDEX.md).


The other lists: [DEV-TOOLS.md](DEV-TOOLS.md) (development tools), [MUSICIAN-TOOLS.md](MUSICIAN-TOOLS.md) (tools for musicians). Hardware knowledge for writing mods: [hardware/](hardware/README.md).
